summary: Tower Semiconductor filed a Form 6-K announcing its 2026 Technical Global Symposium, scheduled for November 17, 2026, in Santa Clara, California, following a prior symposium in Shenzhen, China. The event, aimed at customers and partners, features a CEO keynote, an executive panel on AI infrastructure, and technical sessions on silicon photonics, SiGe, RF SOI, power management, sensors and display platforms. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or structural or regulatory mechanics are disclosed. This is a routine event-notice filing with no special-situation or risk-arb angle.
